Calendar/task records do not confirm the appointment or its outcome. Verify whether it occurred and capture any follow-up instructions. ### 3. Jennifer Walsh / family communications

It contains routine income, housing, utilities, healthcare, travel, education, pet, and other transactions through **June 12, 2026**, but no identified Urban Fitness, Sunrise Medical Group, Westside Pharmacy, prescription #8847, Bob, or Jennifer Walsh transaction. Finance records are point-in-time records and do not prove real-time status.
- Calendar and active-task records contain no actionable entries for Sunrise, Urban Fitness, Bob, Jennifer Walsh, or Dr. Watson. The only near-term calendar item identified was an unrelated tentative Project Phoenix wrap-up on **June 25, 2026**.

### Priority order
1. Review Sunrise portal results and arrange provider follow-up if indicated.
2. Confirm and complete prescription #8847 pickup.
3. Verify the June 18 Dr. Watson follow-up and its next steps.
4. Renew Urban Fitness before **July 15** and confirm payment method/status.
